name: start-reconnect-message
description: Prepares a Reconnect Message to someone who already knows your work, with a reason to write you choose from five, 2 or 3 talking points each with a source, your own draft checked for grammar only and a follow-up date. Use for "run start-reconnect-message", "reconnect with a former colleague", "I have not spoken to them in years", "how do I get back in touch", "reach out without asking for work", "catch up message", "tell an old colleague I am on my own", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
